plans.idea: Same left-to-right order as the original (logo, headline and sub, bottle, Shop Now), stretched across the strip so the brand comes first and the CTA sits as a clear end point on the right.
Product-led: the bottle starts the strip on the left beside the big headline block, and the logo and CTA sit together on the right as one brand-and-action group.
Brand on the left, message in the middle, then the CTA with the bottle as a product image capping the right end, so the eye goes from the logo through the copy to the button and lands on the product.
